findings.severity_label: 🎯 Functional Correctness | 🟡 Minor | ⚡ Quick win
findings.claim: Drop bigint/int8 from the v3 release note. The typed client reconstructs `Date` only; `int8`/`bigint` is explicitly deferred in `packages/stack/src/encryption/v3.ts`, so this changeset promises support the branch does not ship.

findings.severity_label: 🎯 Functional Correctness | 🟡 Minor | ⚡ Quick win
findings.claim: Drop `bigint` from the release note. `.changeset/eql-v3-typed-schema.md:5-7` should describe Date-only support; v3 still omits int8/bigint domains until lossless FFI support exists.

findings.severity_label: 🎯 Functional Correctness | 🟠 Major | ⚡ Quick win
findings.claim: Thread `eqlVersion` into the permission check. The v3 path still calls the v2-oriented `checkPermissions()`, which requires CREATE on `public` for `public.eql_v2_encrypted`. That can incorrectly block native `eql_v3.*` installs for roles that do not need public-schema type creation.

findings.severity_label: 🎯 Functional Correctness | 🟠 Major | ⚡ Quick win
findings.claim: Reject `--migrations-dir` for EQL v3 too. `--migrations-dir` is migration-path-only, but v3 routing skips migration selection and proceeds with direct install. With `--supabase --eql-version 3 --migrations-dir ...`, the flag is silently ignored and the DB is modified directly.

findings.severity_label: 🩺 Stability & Availability | 🟡 Minor | ⚡ Quick win
findings.claim: Guard the structural lock-context check before using `in`. Line 45 can throw a `TypeError` for plain JS callers that pass `null`, `undefined`, or a primitive. Add an object guard so malformed inputs fail downstream consistently instead of crashing in the resolver.

findings.severity_label: 🎯 Functional Correctness | 🟡 Minor | ⚡ Quick win
findings.claim: Narrow structured `.or()` conditions to `FK`. `PendingOrCondition[]` keeps `column: string`, so v3 callers can still compile filters against storage-only encrypted columns via structured `.or(...)`. Make `PendingOrCondition` generic, then bind this overload to `FK`.
